name: Shoko Archives
description: Shoko Archives is a commercial records-management theme for a collection-request landing page. It sets out boxed storage, barcode indexing and next-working-day retrieval from Unit 7, Harlow Mead Trading Estate, Lindenport, founded in 2004. The front page follows one box from the loading dock to a numbered aisle and back to the desk.

summary.en: Records-management landing theme: a cross-fading photo window with the headline and two sub-lines in outlined white boxes, ruled headings with striped square-bullet lists, tabbed photo cards, a parallax aisle band with a docked panel and counted figures, icon rows, a price table and a single booking call to action.
